$comment: Ratcheted ceilings on the surfaces this campaign exists to shrink.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. The campaign produced 132 plan documents and one
mechanism that never failed: EXPECTED_HOST_IMPORT_COUNT, a number in the
repo asserted against a measurement of the built artifact. Every import
change hit it. Meanwhile fork TypeScript grew by 2,867 lines over the same
period with nothing to catch it, and nobody noticed for weeks. Documents
are advisory; a number a test asserts is not.
HOW THE RATCHET WORKS. Exceeding a ceiling fails: the surface grew.
Falling more than `slack` below it ALSO fails, asking you to lower the
ceiling in the same commit. That is what banks a reduction permanently --
without it, one lane's deletion silently funds the next lane's growth.
WHAT A CEILING IS NOT. It is not a goal. Every `target` below is far under
its ceiling, and the gap is the work. See docs/plans/2026-09-11-MASTER-PLAN.md.

forkTypeScript.measure: line count of host/src/fork-*.ts and host/src/vfork-*.ts
forkTypeScript.why: The Rust-First contract says this shrinks toward the floor and does not grow. It grew 23,246 -> 26,113 across the campaign. The target assumes inversion to 3-5 coarse fm_* entries, which collapses transport rather than only orchestration; deletion alone cannot reach it.

workerMainTypeScript.why: Holds the fork drive loop. 6,083 -> 7,536 across the campaign; every fine-grained fm_* call leaves a host-side seeding and base-arithmetic loop behind by construction.

sffsTypeScript.why: The SFFS block filesystem is implemented twice: 3,752 lines here against 3,727 in sffs.rs + sffs_write.rs + sffs_deferred.rs, same superblock geometry, same allocators, same magic. Target is zero because one of the two must go and the kernel owns the format.

hostImportFunctions.measure: env.host_* function imports of the built kernel; see EXPECTED_HOST_IMPORT_COUNT
hostImportFunctions.why: V4, the primary goal: how many functions a new host must implement. Already asserted against the built artifact in crates/host-native; restated here so one file carries every surface. A raw import-ENTRY count reads 73 because env.memory is an entry -- say which you counted.

forkModuleEntryPoints.measure: pub extern "C" fn fm_* declared in crates/fork-module/src/lib.rs
forkModuleEntryPoints.why: The inversion target is 3-5 coarse entries. 69 fine-grained ones are what force the host-side driver loops that make the TypeScript grow.
